card.name: Once daily, right before timing details
card.fires_on: The word daily (or day, dose) at the end of a once-a-day dosing phrase, where a timing phrase such as in the morning, with a meal or after a meal comes next. Also a comma after baseline in monitoring schedules.

modes.label: Once daily
modes.description: The frequency word ends a once-daily instruction and is followed by timing details.
modes.example: Take once<< daily>> with a meal in the morning.

modes.label: Single daily dose
modes.description: Day or dose closes a phrase like a single daily dose or once a day.
modes.example: Administer levothyroxine sodium tablets as a single daily<< dose>>, on an empty stomach

modes.label: Monitoring schedule
modes.description: A comma after baseline in a list of monitoring times.
modes.example: monitor blood cortisol at baseline<<,>> prior to surgery

card.writes: It makes words about timing, such as after, during and before, more likely next, and makes timing nouns less likely.
card.plain: It fires when a once-daily dose has just been stated and a timing detail such as after a meal or in the morning is likely to follow.
